'''Vector 34293AFX''' was the location in which the [[Coruscant Space Traffic Coordination]] cleared the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Merisee Hope]]'' to pass during [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron's]], a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]], insertion to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
